Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks). Bomber jackets are the trail I'm on, and the style should be military (I'll look it over myself, don't you worry). And it ought to be something y'all actually have sitting on a shelf, not just a listing floating around on some website somewhere. Nothing over 1900 cts, y'all (every penny counts, and student loans ain't gonna pay themselves). Past that number the climb gets too steep for me.
